data.exact_reserve_text: A favorable run-off deviation (prior accident year decrease) of GBP 0.9m (2015: adverse run-off deviation of GBP 1.9m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 0.893 million, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This movement reflects mixed development across older underwriting years, with releases for 2012 and 2013, and a significant strengthening for the 2014 year of account.
raw_causal_phrases: favorable run-off deviation (prior accident year decrease) of GBP 0.9m
reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003

data.data_quality_notes: The narrative on page 16 states a 'favorable run-off deviation (prior accident year decrease) of GBP 0.9m', implying a release. However, calculation from the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2012-2014 indicates a net strengthening of GBP 0.893m. The triangle calculation is used as the primary source for the gross prior year development figure, as per instructions to prioritize gross figures from triangles when narrative figures are ambiguous or contradictory and not explicitly stated as gross.
